translations.web: I have made the earth, and created man on it. I, even my hands, have stretched out the heavens. I have commanded all their army.
translations.bsb: It is I who made the earth and created man upon it. It was My hands that stretched out the heavens, and I ordained all their host.
translations.kjv: I have made the earth, and created man upon it: I, even my hands, have stretched out the heavens, and all their host have I commanded.
translations.asv: I have made the earth, and created man upon it: I, even my hands, have stretched out the heavens; and all their host have I commanded.
